SELECT cityname, count(*) AS crashes FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE statename = 'Florida' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many operating power plants on the national map burn coal as their main fuel?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.hifld_power_plants WHERE status = 'OP' AND prim_fuel IN ('BIT', 'SUB', 'LIG')
Which companies hold the most chemistry patents in SureChEMBL?
SELECT substr(assignee, 3, length(assignee) - 4) AS assignee, count(*) AS patents FROM govblock_chemistry.surechembl_patents WHERE assignee <> '[]' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many applications build on a provisional application filed earlier?
SELECT count(DISTINCT application_number) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.patex_continuity_parents_25 WHERE continuation_type = 'PRO'
Which technology fields saw the most patents granted in 2023?

SELECT first_wipo_field_title AS field, count(*) AS patents FROM govblock_patents.pv_annual WHERE cast(assignee_sequence AS varchar) = '0' AND cast(grant_year AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many people living in Queens were born outside the United States?
SELECT value FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 WHERE geo_id = '0500000US36081' AND variable = 'B05002_E013'
Which tissues or body fluids are named most often as where ChEBI compounds were found?
SELECT component_text, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chebi_compound_origins WHERE component_text IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How do the two chambers of the Texas legislature compare in size?
SELECT chamber, count(*) AS members FROM govblock_geo.legislature_members WHERE state_file LIKE 'tx-%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which organisations hold ownership stakes in the most Medicare hospitals?

SELECT organization_name_owner, count(DISTINCT enrollment_id) AS hospitals FROM govblock_health.cms_hospital_all_owners WHERE type_owner = 'O' AND organization_name_owner IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many PubChem bioassays are tied to humans (taxonomy 9606)?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_bioassay_aid2taxid WHERE taxid = 9606
Which companies filed the most 8-K current reports in 2024?

SELECT c.name, count(*) AS reports FROM govblock_sec.submissions_filings f JOIN govblock_sec.submissions_companies c ON c.cik = f.cik WHERE f.form = '8-K' AND substr(cast(f.filingdate AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many U.S. citizens are of voting age, nationwide?
SELECT try_cast(cvap_est AS double) AS citizens_18_plus FROM govblock_elections.cvap_nation WHERE lntitle = 'Total'
Which states send in the most vehicle safety complaints?
SELECT state, count(*) AS complaints FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_complaints GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

Which agencies had the most economically significant rules in the works in fall 2023?

SELECT name, count(DISTINCT rin) AS rules FROM govblock_executive.oira_unified_agenda WHERE publication_id = '202310' AND priority_category LIKE 'Economically Significant%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many documents on Regulations.gov have been withdrawn?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_regulations.regulations_gov_documents WHERE replace(withdrawn, '"', '') = 'True'
Which states have the most hospitals with five-star patient ratings?

SELECT state, count(DISTINCT facility_id) AS hospitals FROM govblock_health.cc_hcahps_hospital WHERE hcahps_measure_id = 'H_STAR_RATING' AND patient_survey_star_rating = '5' AND state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much did used car and truck prices climb from 2020 to 2022?
SELECT year, value FROM govblock_labor.bls_cu_data WHERE series_id = 'CUUR0000SETA02' AND period = 'M13' AND cast(year AS varchar) IN ('2020', '2022') ORDER BY year
Which tissues are studied in the most ChEMBL assays?
SELECT assay_tissue, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_assays WHERE assay_tissue IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the most wind power New York's grid has produced at any one moment?
SELECT max(try_cast(gen_mw AS double)) AS peak_wind_mw FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_fuel_mix_rtfuelmix WHERE fuel_category = 'Wind'
Which agencies obligated the most money through awards in fiscal 2023?

SELECT awarding_toptier_agency_name, sum(try_cast(total_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_award_search WHERE cast(fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2023' AND awarding_toptier_agency_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did U.S. private-sector employment change from 2001 to 2023?
Jobs and Wages by County and Industry
SELECT year, try_cast(annual_avg_emplvl AS double) AS jobs FROM govblock_labor.qcew_annual WHERE area_fips = 'US000' AND agglvl_code = '11' AND own_code = '5' AND year IN ('2001', '2023') ORDER BY 1
Which countries bought the most American crude oil in 2024?

SELECT c.cty_name, sum(try_cast(d.all_val_yr AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_trade.census_exp_detl AS d JOIN govblock_trade.census_exports_country AS c ON c.cty_code = d.cty_code WHERE d.commodity LIKE '2709%' AND d.year = '2024' AND d.month = '12' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many trademark applications were abandoned in 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS abandoned FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_case_file WHERE abandon_dt LIKE '2023%'
What kinds of informal enforcement do regulators use most against water polluters?
SELECT enf_type_desc, count(*) AS actions FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_informal_enforcement_actions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many restaurants were operating in Los Angeles County in 2024?
Jobs and Wages by County and Industry
SELECT year, qtr, qtrly_estabs FROM govblock_labor.qcew_quarterly WHERE area_fips = '06037' AND industry_code = '722511' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' ORDER BY qtr
Which enzyme numbers are linked to the most Rhea reactions?
SELECT id, count(DISTINCT rhea_id) AS reactions FROM govblock_chemistry.rhea_rhea2ec WHERE id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many chemicals were tested in the ToxCast benchmark?
Which agencies obligated the most COVID-19 relief money?

SELECT funding_toptier_agency_name, sum(try_cast(obligation_sum AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_covid_faba_spending WHERE spending_level = 'subtier_agency' AND funding_toptier_agency_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Democrats and Republicans sit in New York's legislature?
SELECT party, count(*) AS members FROM govblock_geo.legislature_members WHERE state_file LIKE 'ny-%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which cities are home to the most SEC filers?
SELECT cityba, stprba, count(DISTINCT cik) AS companies FROM govblock_sec.sec_fsds_sub GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many U.S. reactors are pressurised water and how many boiling water designs?
SELECT substr(reactor_and_containment_type, 1, 3) AS design, count(*) AS reactors FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_dataset_reactors_operating_query_1 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What types of compliance inspection are most common under the Clean Water Act?
SELECT comp_monitor_type_desc, count(*) AS inspections FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_inspections GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of trademark applications are filed before the mark is in use, on an intent-to-use basis?
SELECT round(100.0 * count_if(cast(lb_itu_file_in AS varchar) = '1') / count(*), 1) AS pct_intent_to_use FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_case_file
Which kinds of federal cases fill the docket archive: civil, criminal, bankruptcy or other?

SELECT CASE federal_dn_case_type WHEN 'cv' THEN 'Civil' WHEN 'cr' THEN 'Criminal' WHEN 'bk' THEN 'Bankruptcy' WHEN 'mj' THEN 'Magistrate judge' WHEN 'mc' THEN 'Miscellaneous' WHEN 'ap' THEN 'Adversary proceeding' ELSE federal_dn_case_type END AS case_type, count(*) AS dockets FROM govblock_courts.dockets WHERE federal_dn_case_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of water discharge permits are for major facilities?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN major_minor_status_flag = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_environment.echo_icis_permits
How did mortgage denial rates differ by applicant sex in 2023?

SELECT derived_sex, round(100.0 * count_if(cast(action_taken AS varchar) = '3') / count(*), 1) AS pct_denied FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar WHERE cast(activity_year AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
